desc:
Roll up the garage door and get to work. A wreck lands in your bay. Take it apart bolt by bolt: hood, doors, engine, seats, right down to the bare chassis. Stack your parts, load the truck, turn scrap into a fortune.

🔧 Tear down real vehicles piece by piece, every part comes off
🏍️ Cars, motorcycles and heavy lorries, from beaters to a V12 hypercar
🚛 Sell your haul to the truck, crush the chassis for scrap
🏗️ Drive a fully physics-simulated forklift
👷 Hire a crew of 80+ hands to strip wrecks while you run the business
💼 Hire the front desk: your secretary orders cars and calls trucks for you
📐 Lay your yard out how you like: extra bays, bike stalls, heavy bays
🏆 Climb 17 ranks, past Scrap Kingpin into the prestige ladder
🎁 Daily rewards and offline earnings
🔍 Rare finds hidden in seats and trunks
📱 Full touch controls, made for phone and PC

🚧 WHAT'S NEXT
⚡ Limited-time events: 1.5x XP weekends and more
🚗 More rides on the roster
